meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 先跑回归测试锁定现有行为,再按九类(明显注释、过度防御、死代码等)分多轮清理你改动里的 AI 代码异味,最后过质量门禁并复查;验证不过就回滚或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动中的 AI-slop 模式时触发。默认范围是分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可由调用方传入文件列表。

say.text: 帮我把最近这些改动里的 AI 代码异味清一清
say.note: 先跑回归测试锁定行为,再分类清理

say.text: 清理一下 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 这两个文件
say.note: 你给的文件列表会成为清理范围

say.text: 看看有没有文件超过 250 行,超了就帮我拆成模块
say.note: 会先给出拆分方案再执行

howto.what_en: Locks current behavior with regression tests first, then runs categorized cleanup passes over your changed files, then verifies with quality gates and a review. Failing checks trigger a revert or direct edit.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff against merge-base main; a file list may be passed instead.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in my recent changes
say_en.note: Runs regression tests first to lock behavior, then cleans up
The files you name become the cleanup scope

say_en.text: Any file over 250 lines? Split it into modules
say_en.note: Presents a split plan before executing
